hotkey_note: Options: alt_l/alt_r (Option), cmd_r, ctrl_r, shift_r, f5..f19. Set from Settings.
mode_note: hold_or_lock = hold to talk, double-tap to lock hands-free (tap again to stop). Also: push_to_talk, toggle.
chord_guard_ms_note: If a different key goes down within this many ms of the hotkey (or was already held when the hotkey landed), it's treated as someone else's keyboard shortcut, not a dictation tap, and ignored.
work_timeout_seconds_note: Last-resort safety net: if transcription+cleanup ever runs longer than this, the app gives up on it and resets. Click the × on the island to cancel sooner at any time.
asr_language_note: Only used by the Whisper speech model. 'auto' = detect; 'hi' for Hindi/Hinglish. Parakeet ignores this.
hindi_script_note: 'devanagari' keeps Hindi in हिंदी script; 'latin' romanises it to casual Hinglish (needs AI cleanup on).
learn_words_note: Watches your typing ONLY for learn_correction_window_seconds right after a dictation is pasted/copied -- not continuously. The idea: if you go back and retype a misheard word, that's learned immediately. Unusual (not English, not already known) single-word tokens only, never phrases; password fields are excluded by macOS; every add shows an Undo toast.
learn_correction_window_seconds_note: How long after a dictation is pasted that typing is watched for a correction.
smart_formatting_note: When true (and AI cleanup on), spoken lists/enumerations become numbered or bulleted lists with line breaks.
max_glossary_terms_note: How many dictionary terms to hand the cleanup LLM per utterance (proper nouns / acronyms / product names are prioritised). The full dictionary is still used for literal '=>' corrections. Raising this improves rare-term recall but slows cleanup.
ghost_text_note: Shows a faded, periodically-updated preview of what you're saying above the island while recording. Not true word-by-word streaming -- it's a re-transcription of the growing clip every ghost_text_interval_seconds, so earlier words can shift as you keep talking. Clears the instant you stop; the final pasted text is unaffected.
keep_model_loaded_note: true = the Ollama cleanup model stays in RAM forever (no ~15s wake-up lag; uses that model's RAM even when idle).
hindi_model_note: Small model used ONLY to romanise Devanagari when hindi_script=latin. Empty = use the main model. gemma3:4b (~3.3GB) transliterates reliably.
remote_enabled_note: Lets another device on your Tailscale tailnet (e.g. a phone) send audio and get back the same cleaned-up text the hotkey produces, over the existing models -- no second model load. Needs a remote_token set. Binds only to the Mac's Tailscale IP, never 0.0.0.0.
remote_port_note: Port the remote dictation server listens on. Changing this needs a restart (same as hotkey/model changes) to rebind the socket.
remote_token_note: Pairing secret the remote device must send as 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'. Generate one from Settings -- an empty token refuses all remote requests. Lives only in your local config.json, never committed.
remote_also_paste_locally_note: When true, text dictated from a remote device is ALSO pasted at the Mac's own cursor (handy if you're dictating into something open on the Mac itself). Off by default.
